summary.text: Oletha Faust Goudeau is a Democratic member of the Kansas Senate representing District 29 (Sedgwick County), and the Legislature's member page lists service in the Senate since 2009.
Oletha Faust Goudeau is listed as the ranking minority member of the Commerce Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to the same page, Oletha Faust Goudeau served in the House (2003–2008) before the current service in the Senate that began in 2009.
Oletha Faust Goudeau is listed as a member of the Commerce Committee, the Federal and State Affairs Committee and the Local Government, Transparency and Ethics Committee.
The Legislature lists Oletha Faust Goudeau's occupation as Community Activist.
